# Explain the repository split in the Neo introduction

## Context
Tobi requested a focused refresh of `learn/benefits/Introduction.md` for the repository split, using the README's existing map, and a fresh reading of whether the guide still resonates.

## The Problem
The introduction acknowledges sibling repositories but never maps all five homes. Its Brain detail/claims sections still imply Engine-local `ai/` paths; some point to the retired DreamService file. Pre-split code/history counts still read like fresh-checkout measurements. The embedded roster omits later maintainers.

## The Architectural Reality
The Engine README and each sibling's live dev README agree on Engine, Brain, Agent Institution, DevIndex, and Skills ownership. Brain dev contains `src/evolution/RemDigestion.mjs` and `ai/services/graph/GoldenPathSynthesizer.mjs`; its current Dream Pipeline guide separates digestion from scheduled ranking. The two hemispheres describe responsibilities, not a count of repositories.

## The Fix
Add a compact repository/adoption map within section 4; qualify source roots and link present mechanisms in their owning repository; mark June/July monorepo measurements as historical; route the current roster to the README. Preserve the narrative, Grace's attributed account, and the thesis/measurement distinction.

## Contract Ledger
| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repository map and reader doors | Engine/sibling dev READMEs | Five correct homes with adoption purpose, two hemispheres retained | N/A | Introduction section 4 | Live repository/blob reads |
| Brain references and historical measurements | Brain source + Dream Pipeline guide; existing dated receipts | Correct source ownership; historical methods labeled | No claim to reproduce old totals from fresh split clones | Introduction sections 4, 6, 9–11 | Link/blob checks and diff |
| Guide integrity | Existing fingerprint checker and guide-authoring bar | Whole readable guide with unchanged attributed account | N/A | Introduction | Fingerprint, link check, Mermaid render |

Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0018; no apex change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Section 4 maps all five repositories and distinguishes operator product/shared skills from the two hemispheres.
- [ ] Changed Brain source pointers resolve; current pipeline names match source; pre-split measurements are explicitly dated historical evidence.
- [ ] The current roster is linked from the README; Grace's complete section 7 and the 12-section narrative remain intact.
- [ ] Relative links, declared fingerprint and the Mermaid diagram are verified; no generated SEO output changes.

## Out of Scope
A new identity positioning, rewrite of the lived account, new market/benchmark claims, refreshing historical measurements, or runtime changes.

## Related
Standalone guide refresh; the README roster update is a separate lane.

Creation sweeps: latest 20 created-order open issues and latest 30 all-status A2A checked immediately before filing; no overlapping Introduction lane. Five own open issues, none owning this guide. Broad MC queries on Introduction, split ownership and v13 framing returned no usable prior mapping; session-scoped recovery and current repository artifacts were used. KB could not synthesize the split, so live GitHub/readme/source verification supplies the evidence.
